Based on the contributor statistics from the PyTorch-GAN project, the person with the most contributions in terms of number of commits is **Erik Linder-Norén** with **85 commits**. 

**Complete contributor breakdown:**
1. Erik Linder-Norén (eriklindernoren@live.se) - 85 commits
2. eriklindernoren (eriklindernoren@gmail.com) - 60 commits
3. pinnacle (pinnacle.chen@qq.com) - 8 commits
4. zhampel (17304045+zhampel@users.noreply.github.com) - 3 commits
5. 7 other contributors with 1 commit each

**Note:** There are two entries that appear to be the same person (Erik Linder-Norén) using different email addresses. If combined, Erik Linder-Norén would have a total of 145 commits (85 + 60). However, based on the GitLab contributor statistics, they are counted separately as different contributors with different email addresses. The highest single contributor entry is Erik Linder-Norén with 85 commits.
